escalations.title: Handlebars.js Remote Code Execution via ts-jest
escalations.detail: ts-jest@29.1.2 depends on handlebars@4.7.8 (transitive). Handlebars has 5 high/critical CVEs including JavaScript injection via AST type confusion (CVSS 9.8). RCE possible in template compilation pipeline.
escalations.recommendation: Update ts-jest to a version that removes handlebars dependency, or replace ts-jest with an alternative. Block PRs until patched.

p1_findings.title: Verification gates entirely non-functional — node_modules not installed
p1_findings.detail: Source/Backend/node_modules contains only .vite (20 KB). Source/Frontend has no node_modules at all. All 14 backend test files fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. npm test --workspaces cannot pass.
p1_findings.recommendation: Run npm install in Source/Backend/ and Source/Frontend/ before any pipeline run. Add a pre-flight dependency check to the pipeline entry script.
p1_findings.sprint: This sprint — blocks all other testing

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer has critical blind spot — portal/ and platform/ not scanned
p1_findings.detail: Enforcer scans only Source/ and E2E/. It reports TRACEABILITY PASSED while portal/ (95+ FRs) and platform/ (FR-TMP-001–010) are completely invisible. Running against dev-workflow-platform plan returns 34 MISSING. PASSED is a false green.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add portal/ and platform/ to enforcer scan paths, or create separate enforcer invocations per app. Update inspector.config.yml to enumerate all three source dirs.

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search not wired in Source/Backend/src/app.ts
p2_findings.detail: search.test.ts explicitly flags endpoint NOT wired. app.ts registers 5 route prefixes but has no /api/search. Any request returns 404.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register it in app.ts. Test contract already documented in search.test.ts.

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Prometheus histogram missing from metrics.ts
p2_findings.detail: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 metrics. metrics.ts exports only 3. dependencyCheckDuration histogram is absent. Acceptance criteria: all 4 metrics visible at GET /metrics.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Histogram export to metrics.ts and record it in dependency.ts around computeHasUnresolvedBlockers and isReady calls.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing not implemented anywhere in Source/Backend
p2_findings.detail: CLAUDE.md mandates OTel tracing with traceparent propagation and auto-instrumentation. Zero OTel packages or spans anywhere in Source/Backend. Structured logging and Prometheus present; tracing entirely absent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Install @opentelemetry/api, @opentelemetry/sdk-node, @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node. Add instrumentation.ts entrypoint before app.ts loads. Add // Verifies: FR-021.

p2_findings.title: Express 4.18.2 is 4 minor versions behind (missing security patches)
p2_findings.detail: express@4.18.2 vs current 4.22.2. 4 minor versions behind = potential missing security patches. express@5.2.1 also available (breaking API changes).
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update express@4 (low risk, patch-level)

p2_findings.title: Pino 8.17.0 is two major versions behind
p2_findings.detail: pino@8.17.0 vs latest 10.3.1. Two major versions behind suggests significant changes.
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update pino@8 (conservative) or evaluate pino@10 breaking changes.

p2_findings.title: Vite 5.4.0 has 4 moderate CVEs (path traversal, esbuild injection)
p2_findings.detail: vite@5.4.0 has path traversal in optimized deps .map handling and esbuild enables any website to send requests to dev server. Cascades to @vitest/mocker and vite-node.
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite (latest 8.0.13 has fix). Major version jump 5→8 — test build pipeline thoroughly.

p2_findings.title: React 18.3.1 is one major version behind React 19
p2_findings.detail: react@18.3.1 vs latest 19.2.6. React 19 now stable; 18.x will receive fewer security updates.
p2_findings.recommendation: Plan React 19 migration (non-trivial, 1-2 sprint effort). Not an immediate blocker.

p3_findings.title: Two logger abstractions violate single-sink rule
